messages:
lina: Quick sync — we need to lock the eligibility & acceptance criteria for Private/VPC beta partners by EOD Friday. I sketched a proposal below.

sam: 👍 share the sketch. do we have customer nominations already?

lina: Yes — 6 candidates from PS and AE. Main constraints: 1) must have low-latency regional need, 2) legal ok with bringing a private control plane, 3) willing to commit to 3-week pilot with ops runbook.

anya: From eng POV, we should also require a short SLA window for canary (p95 latency target) and a signal set for regressions. otherwise rollouts get messy.

mike: +1. Add security gating: must pass a quick data-flow checklist and provide a KMS contact. No exceptions for production data until we've done HSM integration test.

eva: Customer success flagged that partners need clear rollback/playbook steps and a dedicated contact for triage during pilot hours. They prefer a weekly touchpoint cadence.

jordan: Ops note — our capacity to support private installs is limited. We should prioritize partners that are on one of three approved cloud providers (aws/gcp/azure) and agree to use our vetted VPC peering configuration.

lina: Proposed compact criteria (for review):
- Business: clear ROI case (latency/cost or compliance)
- Commitment: 3-week pilot, weekly touchpoints, production traffic <= 5%
- Tech: runs on approved cloud, agrees to our peering/KMS pattern, provides test datasets for evals
- Security: signs interim NDA + fills data-flow checklist
- Ops: canary latency SLA during pilot (p95 target), defined rollback triggers

sam: Those look good. For rollout triggers, can we be specific on rollback triggers? e.g., "error rate > 3% for 30m" or "latency regression > 2x baseline for 15m"

anya: I like concrete thresholds. Also add quality regression: if model hallucination rate on our eval set increases by >10% vs baseline, pause traffic. We'll need eval harness in place before pilot starts.

mike: Security approval requires filling this snippet pre-onboarding:
```
- data_flow_document: url to doc or blob
- kms_contact: name + email
- allowed_ingress_ips: CIDR list
- poc_artifact_signoff: yes/no
```
Please make this mandatory.

eva: Can we offer a short incentive (free month of Dedicated capacity) for partners who complete the checklist and provide prioritized feedback? It helps conversion into Dedicated contracts.

jordan: Ops asks for a scheduling window for installs — prefer week-of-Mon/Tue for low friction. Also, we need an internal runbook owner assigned before partner signs up.

lina: Action items I captured:
1) sam — add rollback thresholds to the intake doc (due Thu)
2) anya — wire up eval harness + baseline tests (due Thu)
3) mike — publish security checklist template (due Wed)
4) eva — draft partner incentive language and weekly touchpoint template (due Thu)
5) jordan — confirm install windows and assign runbook owner (due Wed)

sam: I'll update the intake doc and ping legal for the interim NDA language.

anya: I'll prototype the eval harness on a small sample and share the run commands.

mike: Security checklist will be in the shared drive by EOD Wed.

eva: I'll prep the CS playbook + incentive messaging and send a candidate outreach template.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled privacy/security review slot on calendar — Thu 15:00 UTC.

lina: Great. Final ask — can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when their item is locked? We'll close this thread after all checks.

sam: :white_check_mark:

anya: :white_check_mark:

mike: :white_check_mark:

jordan: :white_check_mark:

eva: :white_check_mark:

lina: Thanks all — will merge into the partner intake doc after Wed's security checklist is live.
